turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
```mermaid
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue in STE]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report residue, evaporation, operative sentence, and finding]
    AS3 --> AS4["This is a finding, not a draft."]
    AS4 --> STOP([Stop])

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> W[Wait for answer]
    W --> B

    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C{Check Audience, Scope, Format, Path, and speak test for HUMAN}
    C -->|Gaps| D{How many gaps?}
    D -->|Three or fewer| D1[Ask one question naming the gaps]
    D -->|Four or more| D2[Ask three largest gaps and state assumptions for the rest]
    D1 --> W
    D2 --> W

    C -->|Above floor| E[Compress the prompt]
    E --> E1{Did the cut remove specification?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Name decorative or destructive cut and revert]
    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No| E3{Two consecutive Cut: nothing.?}
    E3 -->|Yes| F[Contract is minimal]
    E3 -->|No| E4{Floor still passes?}
    E4 -->|No| E5[Return last passing version]
    E5 --> F
    E4 -->|Yes| E
    F --> G["Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?"]

    G -->|Keep negotiating| E
    G -->|Freeze, execute, or run it from named human signer| H{Execution tools available?}
    H -->|No| H1[Keep gate closed and report no execution]
    H -->|Yes| I["Contract frozen. Executing."]
    I --> J{Result}
    J -->|Success| K[Done]
    J -->|Floor item fails| L["Failed on [item]. Contract reopened."]
    L --> E

    style H1 fill:#3a1a1a,stroke:#c44,color:#fff
    style G fill:#1a2a3a,stroke:#48c,color:#fff
    style K fill:#1a3a1a,stroke:#4c4,color:#fff
    style AS4 fill:#2a2a1a,stroke:#cc4,color:#fff
```
